views.name: effective_candidates
views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.source_id,
    c.document_id,
    c.payload,
    c.status,
    c.created_at,
    c.reviewed_by,
    c.reason,
    COALESCE(r.payload, c.payload) AS effective_payload
   FROM private.ingestion_candidates c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate_revisions.payload
           FROM private.candidate_revisions
          WHERE candidate_revisions.candidate_id = c.id
          ORDER BY candidate_revisions.created_at DESC, candidate_revisions.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON true;

views.name: published_work_receipts
views.definition:
SELECT s.work_id,
    s.publication_version,
    s.payload,
    s.created_at
   FROM publication_snapshots s
     JOIN publication_heads h ON h.work_id = s.work_id AND h.publication_version = s.publication_version
  WHERE s.approved AND s.withdrawn_at IS NULL;
